args: set -euo pipefail; export DSH_HOME=$(mktemp -d); p="$PWD/adapters/dsh"; npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2 --profile tdcheck --from-default-profile headless --dump-config > /dev/null; npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2 plugin --profile tdcheck add "$p"; out=$(npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2 --profile tdcheck --patch "$p/cordis.patch.yml" --dump-config); echo "$out" | grep -q dsh-tier-drop; echo "$out" | grep -q mcp-tier-drop
set -euo pipefail; for k in 'pi/agent/extensions' 'mcp-remote' 'pi/agent/skills'; do grep -q -- "$k" adapters/README.md || { echo "missing Pi difference: $k"; exit 1; }; done

objective: Independently verify the dsh adapter, repeat the isolated composition check, and confirm the Pi section and that ~/.dsh was not modified.

outputs.purpose: QA verdict for S-07 with the composition transcript.

risk_controls: Run in a separate QA context that never implemented the slice; do not edit implementation files; a verdict is accept or reject with the failing check and defect list.
The isolated DSH_HOME is a temporary directory; ~/.dsh is never touched.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's forbidden organisation name (grep pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden phrase (grep pattern needs[ ]you); plain, specific prose.
rollback: Delete qa/V-07 and the temporary DSH_HOME; the implementation branch is unchanged.
steps: Repeat the isolated DSH_HOME composition check from scratch.
Confirm a tool argument carrying ledgerDir is rejected.
Confirm the Pi section has the three differences and does not claim a built Pi adapter.
Confirm ~/.dsh was not modified (stat -f %m ~/.dsh/profiles/headless/cordis.patch.yml unchanged versus the value recorded before the slice).
